items.title: Turning Cloudflare’s threat indicators into real-time WAF rules
items.author: Cloudflare Blog
items.summary: Cloudflare customers can now use Cloudforce One threat intelligence directly within the WAF to block high-risk traffic. By using new cf.intel fields, security teams can automate protection against specific threat actors and targeted industries in real time.
